en: I'm the eldest of the BIRD\nBROTHERS.\pThe best thing about birds…\nIt has to be the beak.
Oh, so sharp!
You can fly to FOUR ISLAND from\nhere.
I'm the middle kid of the BIRD\nBROTHERS.\pThe best thing about birds…\nIt has to be the wings.
Flap, flap!
There was a really somber guy\nover that way.
I'm the youngest of the BIRD\nBROTHERS.\pThe best thing about birds…\nIt has to be the down.
Down is so comfy…\nIt makes me drowsy…
It fills me with happiness when\nbird POKéMON beg playfully…
Scrub, scrub…
Hello…\nYour POKéMON look healthy…
This is where I buried my ONIX…\nIt was named TECTONIX…
“Here lies TECTONIX” is engraved\non a boulder.\pThere is a LEMONADE placed as an\noffering in front of the grave.
Would you like to leave another\nLEMONADE as an offering?
{PLAYER} placed a can of LEMONADE\nin front of the grave.

Th-thank you…\pThat was my TECTONIX's favorite
drink…\pI don't even know you, but your
act of kindness…\pIt's uplifted me a little.\pCan you please take this as my
thanks?
Please be good to your POKéMON,\ntoo.
If you don't have room for it,\nI'll hold it for you till next time.
Oh, it's you from that time…\pI still have that thing I wanted\nyou to have as my thanks.
Scrub, scrub…\p… … …\nTECTONIX…
Boulders and rocks are neatly piled\nup as a cairn.\p“Here lies TECTONIX” is engraved\non a boulder.
